invariants.rationale: The method always returns a Pair.of(...), so result is guaranteed non-null at exit.
The first value of the returned Pair is the partitionPathStatMap (always non-null).
The second value of the returned Pair is the globalStat (always non-null).
The method expects a valid inputRecords list (null would throw NPE on stream()).
globalStat is not an entry in partitionPathStatMap; they are distinct objects by construction.
